clue.text: With penetrating punch one's finding them?

definitions.text: With penetrating punch one's finding them?

indicators.note: one piece penetrating another is pushed inside it, so the letter for with goes into the word for punch

parts.note: a jab is a short quick punch
taken as ONES, the possessive's apostrophe ignored

explanation.surface: A boxer's punch lands on the face and finds the bones underneath.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue does double duty: a punch that gets through will find the jaw's bones, and the wordplay builds them as well.
explanation.definitionFit: A penetrating punch to the face connects with the bones of the lower face, which are what it finds.

clue.text: Bit of lung from bodies of calves, solid

indicators.note: the body of a word is what is left when its head and tail are cut away, so each word loses its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A butcher's note on a cut of offal taken from solid young cattle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bodies of' applies to both 'calves' and 'solid', giving ALVE and OLI.
explanation.definitionFit: Alveoli are the tiny air sacs at the ends of the lung's airways, so each is a small part of the organ.

clue.text: Jack smothered in chest ointment? You should steer clear of me!

definitions.text: You should steer clear of me!

indicators.note: something smothered in a substance is covered by it all round, so the jack letter is enclosed

parts.note: a box is a chest
unction is an old word for an ointment
J is the card abbreviation for jack

explanation.surface: Someone buried in chest rub warns others to keep their distance.
explanation.walkthrough: A box junction is the yellow criss-crossed area painted at British road crossings, which drivers must not enter unless their exit is clear.
explanation.definitionFit: Drivers must keep out of the yellow hatched road area unless their way out is clear, so it speaks as something to avoid.

clue.text: Girl, new, given a help up

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for help is read from bottom to top

parts.note: aid means help

explanation.surface: A young newcomer gets a leg up from someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Nadia is a woman's first name, so it is an example of a girl in crossword terms.

clue.text: Heartfelt sounds from solitary drunk

indicators.note: the answer is what you hear when the two synonyms are spoken

parts.note: solitary means sole, and drunk means full, as in full of drink

explanation.surface: A lone drinker's mournful noises come straight from the heart.
explanation.definitionFit: Something soulful expresses deep feeling, so it is heartfelt; the two are near synonyms.

clue.text: Black-faced, animated little miner

definitions.meaning: a black face is a scowl, so this means bad-tempered
one of the seven dwarfs who dig in the mine in Disney's cartoon Snow White

explanation.surface: A cartoon dwarf comes up from the mine with a sooty face.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Black-faced' looks like coal dust on a miner, but it means scowling.
explanation.definitionFit: A scowling look shows bad temper, and one of Disney's seven dwarfs is named for exactly that mood.

clue.text: Wind up musical —- it's to do with taste

parts.note: a gust is a blast of wind

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the musical's name is read from bottom to top

parts.note: Evita is the Lloyd Webber musical

explanation.surface: Someone tells you to wind up a musical show, then talks about taste.
explanation.definitionFit: Gustative is a formal adjective meaning relating to the sense of taste.

clue.text: Universal code has no room for quiet killer

parts.note: U is the film-rating abbreviation for universal

indicators.note: if there is no room for something it is left out, so the quiet letter is dropped

parts.note: a zip code is the US postal code
P (piano) means quiet in music

explanation.surface: A universal code that leaves no space for a silent assassin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'quiet killer' looks like one phrase, but 'quiet' belongs to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: An Uzi is an Israeli submachine gun, a weapon and so a killer.

clue.text: A pair of taps fill glass in style

indicators.note: the letters fill the glass, sitting inside it

parts.note: a pane is a sheet of glass
the cold and hot taps are marked C and H

explanation.surface: Two taps run to fill a glass with some elegance.
explanation.definitionFit: Panache is flamboyant confidence of manner, a synonym for flair or style.

clue.text: By which even D. Quixote's troubled?

definitions.text: By which even D. Quixote's troubled?

indicators.note: troubled letters are disturbed and thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: Even Don Quixote, a famously perplexed knight, would be stumped by this.
explanation.definitionFit: A vexed question is a much-debated problem, the kind that could trouble even a deluded knight.

clue.text: Your university degree must include old language

indicators.note: including something means holding it inside

parts.note: YR is the short written form of your
a BA is a bachelor of arts degree

explanation.surface: Your university degree has to cover an ancient tongue.
explanation.definitionFit: Yoruba is a language of West Africa, spoken mainly in Nigeria.

clue.text: After strong drink, lift biscuit

indicators.note: after says the word for lift comes after the strong drink

parts.note: F (forte) means strong or loud in music
to lap is to drink as a cat does
to jack is to lift with a jack

explanation.surface: After a stiff drink, someone gets a lift from a snack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'strong drink' looks like spirits, but splits into F and LAP.
explanation.definitionFit: In Britain a flapjack is a chewy oat bar, sold and classed with biscuits.

clue.text: At risk, girl approaching double-bend in off road jeep

indicators.note: the girl and bend letters sit in the rearranged letters
off means out of order, signalling that road jeep is rearranged
approaching means the girl's name comes just before the bend

parts.note: Di is a girl's name
a Z is shaped like a double bend, as on road signs

explanation.surface: A girl drives an off-road jeep towards a double bend, risking danger.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' rearranges ROAD JEEP into JEOPARED, and DIZ goes in it.
explanation.definitionFit: Something jeopardized has been put in danger, so it is at risk.

clue.text: Relish short film, Italy's The Tree, returning

parts.note: pic is short for picture, a film

indicators.note: returning means these letters go back the way they came, right to left

parts.note: il is Italian for the
a lilac is a small flowering tree

explanation.surface: A brief Italian film called The Tree is shown again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Italy's The Tree' reads as a film title, but splits into the Italian article and a tree, both read backwards by 'returning'.
explanation.definitionFit: Piccalilli is a mustard-yellow pickle of chopped vegetables, eaten as a relish.

clue.text: Passages in cutting French article by Reaumur scale the heights initially

indicators.note: cutting into something goes inside it, so the little word in sits within the rest

parts.note: la is French for the
R stands for the Reaumur temperature scale

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of the words the and heights

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A puzzling sentence about French grammar, a temperature scale and climbing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cutting' puts IN into LABYRTH, which is LA, BY, R and the TH from 'the heights initially'.
explanation.definitionFit: A labyrinth is a maze, a confusing network of passages.

clue.text: Cross into poet's past, finding obstacle

indicators.note: into means the cross letter is put inside

parts.note: o'er is the poetic short form of over, meaning past
X is a cross

explanation.surface: A cross poet runs into a problem with the past.
explanation.walkthrough: An oxer is a fence in showjumping and hunting.
explanation.definitionFit: An oxer is a fence with a rail, a jump horses must clear, so an obstacle.

clue.text: Mum's taken off top coat

indicators.note: taken off means removed, so the word for mum comes out

parts.note: the maximum is the top amount
taken as written

explanation.surface: Mother removes her outer layer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'top coat' looks like one item of clothing, but 'top' is the wordplay, giving MAXIMUM.
explanation.definitionFit: A maxi is a long garment reaching the ankles, such as a long coat.

clue.text: Vessel emerging from a damp Ullapool

indicators.note: emerging from says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A boat comes out of the rain in the Scottish fishing port of Ullapool.
explanation.definitionFit: An ampulla is a flask, especially a Roman two-handled bottle, and so a container.

clue.text: Rent hits the roof, bringing commissions

parts.note: rent means torn apart, or broke
to hit the roof is to fly into a rage

explanation.surface: A landlord raises the rent and a tenant is furious.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rent' looks like a payment, but it is the past of rend, to tear.
explanation.definitionFit: Brokerages are fees an agent charges for arranging deals, so commissions.

clue.text: Fawning debtors' notes cancelled before start of Yankee funeral ceremony

indicators.note: before says the shortened word comes in front of the letter
cancelled means struck out, so the notes are removed

parts.note: obsequious means fawning
an IOU is a debtor's note of what is owed

indicators.note: start of takes the first letter of Yankee

explanation.surface: Grovelling debtors get their notes cancelled before an American's funeral.
explanation.definitionFit: An obsequy is a funeral rite, more usually seen in the plural.

clue.text: Ring in Parisian club has muffled volume

indicators.note: muffled means wrapped up, so the volume letter is held inside

parts.note: en is French for in
an iron is a golf club

explanation.surface: A Paris nightclub turns down the music.
explanation.definitionFit: To environ is to surround or encircle, as a ring does.

clue.text: Weapons expert should be protesting

parts.note: to be up in a subject is to be well versed in it
arms are weapons

explanation.surface: An arms expert ought to be campaigning against them.
explanation.definitionFit: Being angry and protesting loudly is an idiomatic sense of the phrase.

clue.text: Lady carried bare encouragement for singer?

parts.note: go! is a shout of encouragement
a diva is a leading female singer

explanation.surface: A nude lady is cheered on like a performer.
explanation.walkthrough: Lady Godiva rode naked through Coventry, in English legend.
explanation.definitionFit: The legend has a noblewoman borne by her horse through Coventry without clothes.

clue.text: Spurs' English wingers

parts.note: gees means spurs on, as in gees up

explanation.surface: A football report about the wide players at Tottenham Hotspur, nicknamed Spurs.
explanation.walkthrough: Spurs is the nickname of Tottenham Hotspur, a London football club; wingers are wide attacking players.
explanation.definitionFit: These birds have wings, so as a crossword joke they are things that wing.

clue.text: Yellow press run that produces juicy stuff

parts.note: lemon is a pale yellow colour
to squeeze is to press
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: The tabloid press runs scandal that produces juicy gossip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yellow press' looks like the sensational newspapers, but splits into colour and pressing.
explanation.definitionFit: A kitchen tool for extracting citrus liquid yields the juice of the fruit.

clue.text: Cut below top of mouth that hurts

indicators.note: below says the cry goes under that letter in the down entry
top of takes the first letter of mouth, the top one in a down clue

parts.note: ow is the cry when something hurts

explanation.surface: A cut under the roof of the mouth is painful.
explanation.definitionFit: To mow is to cut grass or crops.

clue.text: Religious ruling bulging with wrath, regularly

parts.note: fat means bulging or plump

indicators.note: regularly takes alternate letters, here the first, third and fifth of wrath

explanation.surface: A cleric's decree swollen with fury.
explanation.definitionFit: A fatwah is a ruling on Islamic law given by a recognised authority.

clue.text: Giving change in left one edgy

indicators.note: change says the letters are reordered

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone nervous on the left is finally giving way to change.
explanation.walkthrough: 'change' shuffles IN, L, I and EDGY together.
explanation.definitionFit: Yielding means giving way under pressure, so it is a synonym for giving.
